description: This file defines a PHP class ImageRenderer that provides rendering logic for images in Markdown content within a Confluence format context. It handles external image URLs distinctly by generating specific HTML elements.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: A custom renderer for images in Markdown content, handling external URLs specially and deferring other rendering to a parent renderer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImageRenderer with an instance of the original image renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an image node, handling external URLs with specific HTML elements, and delegating other images to the parent renderer.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the renderer and propagates to the parent renderer.
